title: 束筒高層結構系統
summary: 以威利斯大樓與 One Magnificent Mile 為例，從框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒如何以內部腹框縮短翼面跨度出發，理解九個 75 英尺方筒的逐段截止，處理預製樹狀柱梁段與沉箱基礎、筒體截止處的力流重分配、混凝土六角束筒，再到邊界層風洞試驗與以柱應變驗證剪力滯後，最後是外殼溫度效應與既有束筒超高層的改造交接。
summaryEn: Using Willis Tower and One Magnificent Mile, start from shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling shortens flange spans with interior web frames, understand the staged termination of nine 75-foot tubes, handle prefabricated column-tree units and caisson foundations, force redistribution where tubes stop and hexagonal concrete bundles, then boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing and verifying shear lag from column strains, ending with envelope thermal effects and the retrofit and handover of an existing bundled-tube supertall.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 剪力滯後與抗傾覆練習：某鋼構框架筒翼面寬 68.6 m，翼面共 16 支柱、每支 0.06 m²，角柱容許應力 200 MPa。以力偶近似抗傾覆能力 M ≈ η·σ_c·ΣA·B。單一大筒中央與角柱應力比 r = 0.4，η = 1 − (2/3)(0.6) = 0.60，M ≈ 0.60×200×10⁶×(16×0.06)×68.6 ≈ 7.9 GN·m；改為 3×3 束筒，內部腹框使 r 提高到 0.85，η = 0.90，M ≈ 11.9 GN·m，增加約 50%。若窗間梁變淺使單筒 r 降到 0.3，η ≈ 0.53，M 只剩約 7.0 GN·m。也就是說，在角柱應力相同的前提下，束筒的內部腹框把同樣的鋼柱變成更有效的抗傾覆力偶；代價是內部多了框架線，影響平面使用。數值為教學假設，不代表威利斯大樓的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Shear lag and overturning exercise: a steel framed tube has a 68.6 m flange with 16 columns of 0.06 m² each and an allowable corner stress of 200 MPa. Approximating overturning resistance as a couple, M ≈ η·σ_c·ΣA·B. For a single large tube with a centre-to-corner ratio r = 0.4, η = 1 − (2/3)(0.6) = 0.60 and M ≈ 0.60×200×10⁶×(16×0.06)×68.6 ≈ 7.9 GN·m; as a 3×3 bundle whose interior webs raise r to 0.85, η = 0.90 and M ≈ 11.9 GN·m, about 50% more. If shallower spandrels drop the single tube's r to 0.3, η ≈ 0.53 and M falls to about 7.0 GN·m. For the same corner stress, then, the bundle's interior webs turn the same steel columns into a more effective overturning couple, at the price of extra interior frame lines that affect floor planning. Values are teaching assumptions, not Willis Tower's design values.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法」與「九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps" and "Nine 75-foot tubes and staged terminations": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「框架筒剪力滯後」如何影響束筒高層結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shear lag in a framed tube” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 框架筒以密排的外柱與深窗間梁組成一個「有孔的箱」，側力下垂直於風向的翼面柱以軸力抵抗傾覆。但力量要經由窗間梁的剪力從角柱傳到翼面中央，梁有彈性，中央柱分到的軸力比角柱少，這就是剪力滯後，使翼面的效率降低。翼面越寬，滯後越嚴重。束筒把建築分成幾個較小的筒，筒與筒之間的內部框架也是腹面，等於把翼面切成較短的跨度，讓翼面柱的軸力分布更均勻，整體抗傾覆效率提高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「框架筒剪力滯後」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A framed tube uses closely spaced exterior columns and deep spandrel beams to form a perforated box, and under lateral load the flange columns perpendicular to the wind resist overturning in axial force. But force must travel from the corner columns to the middle of the flange through shear in the flexible spandrels, so middle columns pick up less axial force than corner columns; this shear lag lowers flange efficiency, and the wider the flange, the worse it gets. A bundled tube divides the building into several smaller tubes whose shared interior frames also act as webs, cutting the flange into shorter spans so that flange-column forces are more uniform and overall overturning efficiency rises. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shear lag in a framed tube” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線近似翼面柱應力 σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²]，平均效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Approximate flange-column stress with a parabola σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²], giving an average efficiency η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「框架筒的翼面柱會平均分擔傾覆力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Flange columns of a framed tube share overturning force equally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「框架筒剪力滯後」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shear lag in a framed tube”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「框架筒剪力滯後」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shear lag in a framed tube” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線近似翼面柱應力 σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²]，平均效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r)。單一寬筒中央與角柱應力比 r = 0.4 時 η = 0.60；束筒內部腹框使 r 提高到 0.85 時 η = 0.90，同樣角柱應力下翼面能提供的抗傾覆力約增加 50%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Approximate flange-column stress with a parabola σ(x) = σ_c·[r + (1 − r)(2x/b)²], giving an average efficiency η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − r). For a single wide tube with a centre-to-corner stress ratio r = 0.4, η = 0.60; interior web frames in a bundle raising r to 0.85 give η = 0.90, so for the same corner stress the flange provides about 50% more overturning resistance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維模型中輸出側力下翼面各柱的軸力分布，計算中央與角柱的比值，並比較單筒與束筒配置；同時確認窗間梁的剪力與變形是否在設計範圍，因為滯後的程度直接取決於這些梁的勁度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output the axial-force distribution across flange columns under lateral load from the three-dimensional model, compute the centre-to-corner ratio and compare single-tube and bundled layouts; check also that spandrel shears and deformations are within design, since the degree of shear lag depends directly on their stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「框架筒剪力滯後」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shear lag in a framed tube” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維模型中輸出側力下翼面各柱的軸力分布，計算中央與角柱的比值，並比較單筒與束筒配置；同時確認窗間梁的剪力與變形是否在設計範圍，因為滯後的程度直接取決於這些梁的勁度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output the axial-force distribution across flange columns under lateral load from the three-dimensional model, compute the centre-to-corner ratio and compare single-tube and bundled layouts; check also that spandrel shears and deformations are within design, since the degree of shear lag depends directly on their stiffness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在設計報告中列出翼面柱的軸力分布圖與剪力滯後比，角柱與其續接按實際最大軸力設計；建築若要加大窗洞或改變窗間梁深度，須由結構工程師重新評估滯後效應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Include flange-column force distributions and shear-lag ratios in the design report, design corner columns and their splices for the actual maximum force, and have the structural engineer reassess shear lag before any enlargement of windows or change in spandrel depth.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若設計時以平面保持平面的梁理論假設翼面柱均勻受力，角柱的實際軸力會被低估，可能在強風或地震時先行降伏或在續接處開裂；窗間梁若因開大窗而變淺，剪力滯後加劇，整棟樓比預期柔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming plane sections and uniform flange forces in design underestimates real corner-column forces, which can yield first or crack at splices in strong wind or earthquakes; shallower spandrels from larger windows worsen shear lag and leave the building more flexible than expected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 框架筒的剪力滯後與束筒的解法：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「框架筒剪力滯後」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shear lag in a framed tube” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若設計時以平面保持平面的梁理論假設翼面柱均勻受力，角柱的實際軸力會被低估，可能在強風或地震時先行降伏或在續接處開裂；窗間梁若因開大窗而變淺，剪力滯後加劇，整棟樓比預期柔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming plane sections and uniform flange forces in design underestimates real corner-column forces, which can yield first or crack at splices in strong wind or earthquakes; shallower spandrels from larger windows worsen shear lag and leave the building more flexible than expected. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A bundled tube divides the building into several smaller tubes whose shared interior frames also act as webs, cutting the flange into shorter spans so that flange-column forces are more uniform and overall overturning efficiency rises.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「框架筒的翼面柱會平均分擔傾覆力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Nine 75-foot tubes and staged terminations: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「九筒 3×3 平面」如何影響束筒高層結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nine-tube 3×3 plan” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 威利斯大樓（原西爾斯大樓）由九個約 75 英尺（約 22.9 m）見方、內部無柱的方筒以 3×3 排列組成，底部總寬約 225 英尺（約 68.6 m）。九個筒在第 50 層以下全部存在，之後依序截止：第 50 層西北與東南兩筒結束，第 66 層東北與西南兩筒結束，第 90 層北、東、南三筒結束，只剩兩筒到頂。逐段截止讓上部平面縮小、受風面積減少，同時形成退縮的外觀；但每一次截止都會造成勁度與質量的突然變化，必須在截止層以斜撐或帶狀桁架重新分配力量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「九筒 3×3 平面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Willis Tower, formerly the Sears Tower, consists of nine column-free square tubes about 75 ft (about 22.9 m) on a side arranged in a 3×3 grid, about 225 ft (about 68.6 m) wide at the base. All nine rise to level 50 and then stop in stages: the northwest and southeast tubes end at level 50, the northeast and southwest at level 66, and the north, east and south at level 90, leaving two tubes to the top. Staged termination shrinks the upper plan and reduces wind area while creating the stepped profile; but every termination causes an abrupt change in stiffness and mass, so diagonals or belt trusses at those levels must redistribute forces. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Nine-tube 3×3 plan” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「束筒的筒體可以在任何樓層隨意截止，不需要特別處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「九筒 3×3 平面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nine-tube 3×3 plan” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單筒面積 22.86² ≈ 523 m²：9 筒約 4,703 m²、7 筒約 3,658 m²、5 筒約 2,613 m²、2 筒約 1,045 m²。第 90 層以上的平面只剩底部的約 22%，該段的抗彎慣性矩與受風寬度同時減少，勁度變化可達數倍。尺寸取自公開資料，比例為計算結果。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One tube is 22.86² ≈ 523 m²: nine tubes give about 4,703 m², seven about 3,658 m², five about 2,613 m² and two about 1,045 m². Above level 90 the plan is only about 22% of the base, so bending inertia and windward width both drop, and stiffness can change several-fold. Dimensions are from public sources; the ratios are computed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模型逐段檢查截止層上下的層間變位、勁度比與構件力，確認沒有形成軟弱層；風洞試驗需涵蓋退縮造成的局部風壓與渦流變化，截止層的帶狀桁架或斜撐以局部模型檢核其傳力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check storey drift, stiffness ratios and member forces above and below each termination level in the model to confirm there is no soft storey; wind-tunnel testing must capture local pressures and vortex changes caused by the setbacks, and belt trusses or diagonals at termination levels are checked with local models for force transfer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 以模型逐段檢查截止層上下的層間變位、勁度比與構件力，確認沒有形成軟弱層；風洞試驗需涵蓋退縮造成的局部風壓與渦流變化，截止層的帶狀桁架或斜撐以局部模型檢核其傳力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：截止層要在結構圖上特別標示，列出帶狀桁架或斜撐的位置與功能；建築若要變更退縮樓層，須回到結構與風工程顧問重新評估勁度變化與局部風壓。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Flag termination levels on the structural drawings with the position and purpose of belt trusses or diagonals; any change of setback level must go back to the structural and wind consultants to reassess stiffness changes and local pressures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若截止層沒有足夠的力量重分配構件，被截止筒的角柱軸力會突然集中到相鄰的筒，造成局部超載或接頭破壞；退縮處的局部風壓若被低估，帷幕與屋頂設備容易在強風中受損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without enough redistribution members at a termination level, corner-column forces from the stopped tube concentrate abruptly in the adjacent tube, causing local overload or connection failure; underestimated local wind pressures at setbacks leave cladding and rooftop equipment vulnerable in strong winds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 九個 75 英尺方筒與逐段截止：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: Without enough redistribution members at a termination level, corner-column forces from the stopped tube concentrate abruptly in the adjacent tube, causing local overload or connection failure; underestimated local wind pressures at setbacks leave cladding and rooftop equipment vulnerable in strong winds. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 預製柱梁段與現場螺栓接合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prefabricated column-tree units with field bolting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預製樹狀柱梁段」如何影響束筒高層結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Prefabricated column-tree units” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 束筒的每一面框架都由密排柱與深梁組成，接頭數量極多；SOM 指出威利斯大樓的鋼構在工廠預先組成段落，再運到現場以螺栓接合。常見做法是把柱與兩側半跨的梁在工廠焊成「樹狀」單元，焊接品質在室內控制，現場只在梁的中央以螺栓續接。側力作用下框架梁的反曲點大致在跨中，該處彎矩接近零，因此在跨中續接只需傳遞剪力，接頭可以做得簡單而快速。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預製樹狀柱梁段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every face of a bundled tube is a frame of closely spaced columns and deep beams, so connections are extremely numerous; SOM notes that Willis Tower's steel frame was pre-assembled in sections and bolted together on site. A common approach shop-welds a column with half-span beams on each side into a tree unit, keeping weld quality under indoor control, and splices the beams with bolts only at mid-span on site. Under lateral load the frame beams have their inflection point near mid-span where moment is close to zero, so a mid-span splice need carry only shear and can be simple and quick. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Prefabricated column-tree units” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：側力下梁端彎矩 M = V·L/2：梁剪力 V = 900 kN、淨跨 L = 4.0 m 時柱面彎矩約 1,800 kN·m，跨中接近 0；跨中續接只需傳遞 900 kN 剪力，若每支螺栓承壓容量取 120 kN，需 900/120 = 7.5，取 8 支。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Beam-end moment under lateral load M = V·L/2: with a beam shear V = 900 kN and a clear span L = 4.0 m, the moment at the column face is about 1,800 kN·m and near zero at mid-span; a mid-span splice need only carry 900 kN of shear, so at 120 kN bearing capacity per bolt it needs 900/120 = 7.5, rounded to 8 bolts.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「現場螺栓接頭比工廠焊接接頭弱，所以預製單元沒有好處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Site bolted joints are weaker than shop welds, so prefabricated units bring no benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預製樹狀柱梁段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Prefabricated column-tree units”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 預製柱梁段與現場螺栓接合：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預製樹狀柱梁段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Prefabricated column-tree units” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：側力下梁端彎矩 M = V·L/2：梁剪力 V = 900 kN、淨跨 L = 4.0 m 時柱面彎矩約 1,800 kN·m，跨中接近 0；跨中續接只需傳遞 900 kN 剪力，若每支螺栓承壓容量取 120 kN，需 900/120 = 7.5，取 8 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Beam-end moment under lateral load M = V·L/2: with a beam shear V = 900 kN and a clear span L = 4.0 m, the moment at the column face is about 1,800 kN·m and near zero at mid-span; a mid-span splice need only carry 900 kN of shear, so at 120 kN bearing capacity per bolt it needs 900/120 = 7.5, rounded to 8 bolts. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠焊接的柱梁接頭以超音波全數檢測，樹狀單元出廠前量測尺寸與扭曲；現場螺栓續接檢查孔位對齊、摩擦面與預拉力，並抽查反曲點假設：以模型確認各種載重組合下續接處的彎矩確實很小，否則需改為抗彎續接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Ultrasonically test all shop-welded beam-to-column joints and measure dimensions and twist of tree units before dispatch; on site check hole alignment, faying surfaces and pretension of bolted splices, and confirm with the model that moment at the splice really is small under every load combination, otherwise switch to a moment splice.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 預製柱梁段與現場螺栓接合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prefabricated column-tree units with field bolting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預製樹狀柱梁段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Prefabricated column-tree units” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 工廠焊接的柱梁接頭以超音波全數檢測，樹狀單元出廠前量測尺寸與扭曲；現場螺栓續接檢查孔位對齊、摩擦面與預拉力，並抽查反曲點假設：以模型確認各種載重組合下續接處的彎矩確實很小，否則需改為抗彎續接。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Ultrasonically test all shop-welded beam-to-column joints and measure dimensions and twist of tree units before dispatch; on site check hole alignment, faying surfaces and pretension of bolted splices, and confirm with the model that moment at the splice really is small under every load combination, otherwise switch to a moment splice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預製單元的尺寸容許誤差、出廠量測與運輸支撐方式寫入製造規範；續接位置以模型確認反曲點後定案，任何現場擴孔或改孔須經結構工程師同意並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write tolerances, dispatch measurement and transport support for prefabricated units into the fabrication specification; fix splice locations only after the model confirms the inflection points, and require the structural engineer's approval and a record for any reaming or re-drilling on site.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若某些載重組合（例如重力加風）使反曲點偏離跨中，只按剪力設計的續接會承受未預期的彎矩，螺栓滑動或孔壁撕裂；樹狀單元運輸時若扭曲而未在出廠前發現，現場孔位對不上只能擴孔，削弱接頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Caissons to bedrock” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 芝加哥市中心的地表下是軟弱的黏土層，超高層無法以淺基礎承載。SOM 說明威利斯大樓的各筒坐落在延伸至岩盤的鋼筋混凝土沉箱上，公開資料記載共有 201 支、直徑最大約 3 m。鋼構束筒的柱子密集且重力與傾覆軸力都直接下傳，每一支柱或柱群需要對應的沉箱；迎風側角柱在強風時軸力減少，背風側增加，沉箱必須同時承受最大壓力並確認不會出現淨上拔。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「沉箱基礎至岩盤」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Downtown Chicago has soft clay below the surface, so a supertall cannot sit on shallow foundations. A steel bundled tube has closely spaced columns whose gravity and overturning forces pass straight down, so each column or group needs its own caisson; windward corner columns lose force in strong wind while leeward ones gain, so caissons must carry the peak compression and be checked against net uplift. steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Caissons to bedrock” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：沉箱底部承壓 q = P/A。直徑 3.0 m，A = π×1.5² ≈ 7.07 m²；柱群傳下 P = 60 MN 時 q ≈ 60/7.07 ≈ 8.5 MPa，若岩盤容許承壓 10 MPa，使用率約 85%。迎風側若軸力因風減少 20 MN，仍有 40 MN 壓力，不會上拔。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Caisson base bearing q = P/A. For a 3.0 m diameter, A = π×1.5² ≈ 7.07 m²; a column group delivering P = 60 MN gives q ≈ 60/7.07 ≈ 8.5 MPa, about 85% of an allowable rock bearing of 10 MPa. If wind reduces a windward column group by 20 MN, 40 MN of compression remains and there is no uplift. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支沉箱開挖到岩盤後由大地工程師檢查岩面、清底與入岩深度並簽認，必要時做岩心或載重試驗；澆置混凝土時防止軟土或地下水侵入，完工後以水準測量追蹤各筒的沉陷是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each caisson is excavated to rock, the geotechnical engineer inspects and signs off the rock surface, base cleaning and socket depth, with cores or load tests where needed; prevent soft soil or groundwater intrusion during concreting, and after completion track by levelling whether all tubes settle uniformly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 若沉箱底部殘留軟泥或未真正到達岩盤，該柱群沉陷較大，束筒中相鄰筒之間會產生差異沉陷，梁柱接頭承受附加彎矩；施工時地下水湧入使混凝土離析，沉箱斷面出現缺陷且難以發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 筒體截止層的力流重分配與施工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Force redistribution and construction at tube drop-off levels: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「筒體截止處的帶狀桁架」如何影響束筒高層結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Belt trusses at tube drop-offs” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 當一個筒在某層截止，它的角柱在下方仍承受由上方與自身累積的軸力，而上方已沒有這個筒的框架；截止層以上的傾覆力也必須改由剩下的筒承擔。威利斯大樓在機械層設有帶狀桁架，並在退縮處下方兩層設置斜向構件以減少剪應力，讓力量在數層的範圍內平順地轉移到繼續往上的筒。施工時這些轉換構件必須在上方荷重增加前完成，否則下方柱會在缺少重分配構件的狀態下承受不均勻荷重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「筒體截止處的帶狀桁架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When a tube stops at a given level, its corner columns below still carry the axial force accumulated from above and from themselves, but the tube's frame no longer exists overhead, and overturning above the termination must be taken by the remaining tubes. Willis Tower has belt trusses at mechanical floors and diagonal members in the two storeys immediately below each setback to reduce shear stress, so force passes smoothly over several floors into the continuing tubes. During construction these transfer members must be completed before the load above builds up, otherwise the columns below carry uneven load without the redistribution members in place. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Belt trusses at tube drop-offs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：截止層斜桿力 F = ΔN/(2·sinθ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Diagonal force at a termination F = ΔN/(2·sinθ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帶狀桁架只是機電層的裝飾性構件，可以晚點再裝。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Belt trusses are decorative members in plant rooms and can go in later." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 筒體截止層的力流重分配與施工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force redistribution and construction at tube drop-off levels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「筒體截止處的帶狀桁架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Belt trusses at tube drop-offs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：截止層斜桿力 F = ΔN/(2·sinθ)。帶狀桁架深兩層約 7.9 m、柱距 4.57 m，θ = atan(7.9/4.57) ≈ 59.9°；若截止筒角柱須轉移 ΔN = 8 MN，由兩根斜桿分擔，每根約 4/sin59.9° ≈ 4.6 MN。若只有單層高度，角度變平、斜桿力明顯增加。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Diagonal force at a termination F = ΔN/(2·sinθ). A belt truss two storeys deep, about 7.9 m, with 4.57 m column spacing gives θ = atan(7.9/4.57) ≈ 59.9°; transferring ΔN = 8 MN from a terminated corner column through two diagonals puts about 4/sin59.9° ≈ 4.6 MN in each. With only one storey of depth the angle flattens and diagonal forces rise markedly. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析檢查截止層的帶狀桁架在各施工時點的受力，確認在上方加載前已完成並鎖緊；完工後在截止層上下的角柱設應變計，比對實測軸力分布與模型預測，確認力量確實經由帶狀桁架轉移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check belt-truss forces at termination levels at each construction stage with a construction-stage analysis, confirming they are complete and tightened before load builds above; after completion fit strain gauges to corner columns above and below termination levels and compare measured axial distributions with the model, confirming that force really passes through the belt trusses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 束筒不一定是鋼構方筒。芝加哥的 One Magnificent Mile（1983 年完工、約 205 m、57 層）由 SOM 設計，結構工程師為 Fazlur Khan，以四個高度不同（5、21、49、57 層）的六角形鋼筋混凝土筒束在一起，配合住宅與辦公的不同樓層需求。混凝土框架筒以較厚的外牆與窗間梁形成筒壁，筒與筒共用的牆同時是腹面；六角形平面讓相同樓地板面積所需的周邊框架長度較短，並提供較多的景觀面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混凝土六角束筒」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bundled tube need not be square steel tubes. A concrete framed tube forms its walls from thick perimeter piers and spandrels, and walls shared between tubes act as webs; the hexagonal plan needs a shorter perimeter frame for the same floor area and offers more view frontage. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hexagonal concrete bundle” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 威利斯大樓的設計團隊與西安大略大學的邊界層風洞實驗室（Alan G. Davenport 風工程團隊）合作，這類風洞會在模型上游模擬近地面的紊流邊界層，讓風速隨高度增加並帶有真實的陣風結構。束筒的逐段退縮使不同高度的寬度與形狀改變，風力分布與渦流脫落都和單一方塊不同，必須以試驗確認。公開資料指出結構設計可承受約 130 mph（約 210 km/h）的陣風；風洞結果用於整體風載、層間變位、帷幕風壓與居住舒適度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「邊界層風洞與設計陣風」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：動壓 q = ½·ρ·V²。V = 130 mph ≈ 58.1 m/s，q = 0.5×1.225×58.1² ≈ 2.07 kPa；以 C_d = 1.3、寬 68.6 m、高 442 m 均布估算，總風力約 2.07×1.3×68.6×442 ≈ 81.5 MN，基底彎矩約 81.5×221 ≈ 18.0 GN·m。均布假設偏保守，實際應以風洞剖面為準。係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Dynamic pressure q = ½·ρ·V². The uniform assumption is conservative; the wind-tunnel profile governs. Coefficients are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較風洞量得的基底彎矩、頂層加速度與規範估算，並檢查周邊建築與地形在模型中的模擬範圍；退縮處與屋頂的局部風壓係數用於帷幕設計，結果須經獨立的風工程同儕審查。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 若只以均勻風速剖面或忽略周邊建築做試驗，可能低估都市環境中的紊流與陣風效應，造成居住舒適度不足或帷幕在退縮處受損；周邊新建大樓也可能改變既有建築的風環境，需重新評估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 以柱應變驗證剪力滯後分布：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Verifying shear-lag distribution from column strains: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「柱軸向應變量測」如何影響束筒高層結構系統的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column axial-strain measurement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力滯後的程度取決於窗間梁與接頭的實際勁度，模型假設可能與實際不同。在翼面的角柱、中間柱與內部腹框柱上安裝應變計，可在強風時量測軸力分布，直接計算中央與角柱的比值，驗證束筒的內部腹框是否確實改善了滯後。量測需扣除重力與溫度造成的應變，只保留風引起的變化部分，並與同時段的風速風向對應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「柱軸向應變量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The degree of shear lag depends on the actual stiffness of spandrels and joints, which may differ from model assumptions. Strain gauges on flange corner columns, intermediate columns and interior web-frame columns measure the axial-force distribution during strong winds, giving the centre-to-corner ratio directly and verifying whether the bundle's interior webs really reduce shear lag. Measurements must remove strain from gravity and temperature, keeping only the wind-induced change, matched to concurrent wind speed and direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Column axial-strain measurement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：由實測風致應變求比值：角柱 120 με、翼面中央柱 80 με，r = 80/120 ≈ 0.67，效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − 0.67) ≈ 0.78；若模型預測 r = 0.85（η = 0.90），代表實際滯後較模型嚴重，角柱實際軸力比設計估計高約 0.90/0.78 − 1 ≈ 15%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ratio from measured wind strains: corner column 120 με and mid-flange column 80 με give r = 80/120 ≈ 0.67 and η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − 0.67) ≈ 0.78; if the model predicted r = 0.85 (η = 0.90), the real shear lag is worse than modelled and corner-column force is about 0.90/0.78 − 1 ≈ 15% higher than estimated.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型算出的柱軸力分布一定和實際相同，不需要量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The column-force distribution computed by the model must match reality, so no measurement is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「柱軸向應變量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Column axial-strain measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 以柱應變驗證剪力滯後分布：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Verifying shear-lag distribution from column strains: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱軸向應變量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Column axial-strain measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：由實測風致應變求比值：角柱 120 με、翼面中央柱 80 με，r = 80/120 ≈ 0.67，效率 η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − 0.67) ≈ 0.78；若模型預測 r = 0.85（η = 0.90），代表實際滯後較模型嚴重，角柱實際軸力比設計估計高約 0.90/0.78 − 1 ≈ 15%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ratio from measured wind strains: corner column 120 με and mid-flange column 80 με give r = 80/120 ≈ 0.67 and η = 1 − (2/3)(1 − 0.67) ≈ 0.78; if the model predicted r = 0.85 (η = 0.90), the real shear lag is worse than modelled and corner-column force is about 0.90/0.78 − 1 ≈ 15% higher than estimated. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：選擇風向穩定、風速高的事件，計算各柱應變相對於無風基準的變化，並以同一斷面的兩側應變分離軸力與彎曲；把實測比值與模型比較，差異大時以實測資料校正窗間梁與接頭勁度，再重新檢核角柱與續接容量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Select events with steady direction and high wind speed, compute each column's strain change relative to a calm baseline, and separate axial force from bending using gauges on both sides of each section; compare measured ratios with the model and, where they differ widely, calibrate spandrel and joint stiffness from the data and recheck corner-column and splice capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Envelope and thermal movement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bundled-tube tall-building systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SOM 指出威利斯大樓的黑色鋁板與青銅色玻璃外殼具有隔熱作用，使室內溫度維持相對穩定，進而限制鋼構架的熱脹冷縮。對 400 m 以上的鋼構而言，外圍柱若直接暴露在芝加哥冬夏的溫差中，而內部腹框柱維持室溫，兩者的長度變化不同，會讓樓板在外圍與內部之間傾斜，並在梁與接頭中產生附加內力。外殼的隔熱與氣密因此不只是節能問題，也是結構變形控制的一部分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「外殼與溫度變形」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 黑色鋁皮與青銅色玻璃外殼的溫度效應：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外殼與溫度變形」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：外柱與內柱的長度差 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、L = 400 m：若外柱與內柱溫差 30 °C，ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×400,000×30 = 144 mm，相距 22.86 m 的樓板傾斜約 1/159；外殼隔熱把溫差降到 10 °C 時 ΔL = 48 mm，傾斜約 1/476。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Length difference between exterior and interior columns ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在外圍柱與內部柱設置溫度感測器，冬季與夏季各量測一次柱溫分布，並以精密水準量測樓板高程差，與熱分析預測比較；外殼更新或改造前，評估新材料的隔熱性能對柱溫與結構變形的影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install temperature sensors on perimeter and interior columns, measure column temperature distribution once in winter and once in summer, survey slab level differences by precise levelling and compare with thermal analysis; before any envelope renewal or retrofit, assess how the new materials' insulation will affect column temperatures and structural deformation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 既有束筒超高層的改造與交接紀錄：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Retrofitting and handover records for an existing bundled-tube supertall: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「既有束筒超高層的改造」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Retrofitting an existing bundled tube” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 改造前調閱原始圖說與歷次改造紀錄，以現場量測確認構件尺寸與接頭狀況，必要時取樣試驗鋼材強度與韌性；新增荷重以模型檢核相關筒體與基礎，完成後更新竣工圖與結構資料庫，並記錄新增設備的重量與受風面積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before any alteration, retrieve original drawings and earlier alteration records, confirm member sizes and joint condition by site survey, and where needed sample the steel for strength and toughness; check the added loads on the relevant tubes and foundations with the model, then update the as-built drawings and structural database, recording the weight and wind area of new equipment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應維護一份「結構荷重登錄」，記錄每次改造新增或移除的重量、位置與受風面積，並與原設計容量比較；交接時把原始圖說、改造紀錄與量測資料數位化保存，任何改造須經結構工程師審查簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should keep a structural load register recording the weight, location and wind area added or removed by every alteration and comparing them with original design capacity; at handover digitise original drawings, alteration records and measurements, and require structural engineer review and sign-off for every alteration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改造只檢查新增構件本身而未回溯到下方的筒體與基礎，多次小改造的累積荷重可能超過原設計餘裕；資料遺失時，評估者可能誤判構件的實際尺寸或材料，導致補強不足或過度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only the new members without tracing load down through the tubes and foundations lets the accumulated load of many small alterations exceed the original margin; with records lost, assessors may misjudge actual member sizes or materials, leading to too little or too much strengthening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 既有束筒超高層的改造與交接紀錄：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「既有束筒超高層的改造」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Retrofitting an existing bundled tube” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改造只檢查新增構件本身而未回溯到下方的筒體與基礎，多次小改造的累積荷重可能超過原設計餘裕；資料遺失時，評估者可能誤判構件的實際尺寸或材料，導致補強不足或過度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only the new members without tracing load down through the tubes and foundations lets the accumulated load of many small alterations exceed the original margin; with records lost, assessors may misjudge actual member sizes or materials, leading to too little or too much strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：原始圖說、施工紀錄與歷次改造資料若不完整，評估者只能以保守假設或破壞性調查補足，成本與風險都會增加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If original drawings, construction records and earlier alteration data are incomplete, assessors must fall back on conservative assumptions or destructive investigation, adding cost and risk.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「老建築已經通過時間考驗，增加一些設備不需要結構評估。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An old building has stood the test of time, so adding some equipment needs no structural assessment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
